review_method: Independent read-only review of complete frozen production change, both new controls, full contract document and surrounding packing flow. Local Git object/hash checks only; no Rust tests, formatter, or combined validation rerun by reviewer.

implementation_findings.finding: The 29-line addition runs only in the existing over-budget eviction loop after earlier metadata/duplicate/reference stages. It probes omission of the entire optional source_freshness.validation_work object and changes no SQL subfield or producer.

On a failed fit, the exact owned serde_json::Value receipt is reinserted. Map::insert returns the old marker value: Some(value) is restored verbatim, None removes the trial marker. This correctly preserves absence, false, true, null and any other original Value.

The trial sets details_omitted before invoking the existing measure function. That function includes serialized UTF-8 bytes, the omission marker, used_bytes and token_estimate. After failed restoration, existing loop/final measurements re-account the full object before any successful return.

A successful trial breaks before the next graph/body eviction and preserves every currently retained hit. Subsequent reference allocation and final checks continue measuring the same complete object under the original cap; no post-pack free allowance is introduced.

Diagnostic-only omission sets details_omitted but does not fabricate zero work or mark a completed attempt. Existing body/graph Partial and omission counters remain unchanged or monotone. There is no path that recreates omitted work; subsequent packing preserves the marker and prior omissions.

The byte/token limits, ranking/eviction order, source text, document/source proof, generation, original retrieval-cost values, producer behavior and existing large-diagnostic/minimal-envelope policies are unchanged. Public acceptance still depends on complete-object budget and actual source checks.

control_review.assessment: Real parser/index/context source with explicitly synthetic CAP+64 output pressure; requires the identical complete hit, omitted_hits=0, unchanged existing Partial, all other freshness fields, a true omission marker, actual byte/token accounting, source verification, same-cap idempotence and no resurrection after substage budget expansion.

Independent oversized graph pressure prevents the trial from fitting; graph removal later makes room. Eight combinations cover receipt present/absent and marker absent/false/true/null. Requires the entire original freshness object and hit to survive exactly, graph-only Partial, byte accounting, source verification and idempotence.
